subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should implicit Groq Llama requests preserve tool use and recover only after a matching oversized-request error, or intentionally become chat-only for every organization by default?
rationale: The implementation mechanics are sound, but Groq supports tools and organization limits vary, so choosing a global chat-only default is a provider product and compatibility decision rather than a purely technical correction.

options.title: Preserve tools with recovery
options.body: Keep the existing tool-capable path and add a narrowly classified provider recovery that uses the bounded chat-only payload only after the specific request-size rejection.

options.title: Adopt chat-only defaults
options.body: Accept the capability change for all implicit requests and document that an explicit token budget is required to retain tools.

recommendation.title: Preserve tools with recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the existing tool-capable path and add a narrowly classified provider recovery that uses the bounded chat-only payload only after the specific request-size rejection.
